sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed: the national payment network is still down and 100% of calls from the clearing worker time out at about 2 s. The clearing queue holds 116 items and is growing.
sbar.background: The national payment network, run by an outside organisation, stopped answering, so the clearing worker cannot send payments. The clearing log shows 'payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=92'.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an outage of the external payment network (confidence 0.93), and no allowed action can fix it. Item 92 is waiting because of the network timeout, not because it is malformed, so it is not poison. The pipeline's restart of the screening standby is routine and caused no symptom.
sbar.recommendation: The incident commander escalated this itself to the network operator and asked them to restore service, so follow up with them until the network answers. Do not quarantine item 92; the 116-item clearing queue should drain once the network is back, and the operations team should review the delayed payments.
